nodes.label: Docker Compose Stack (Nginx Edition)
nodes.rationale: Header says Nginx Edition: no traefik service; Odoo ports bound to 127.0.0.1 for an external Nginx proxy.

nodes.label: Backup & Recovery (pg_dump per tenant, filestore tar)
nodes.norm_label: backup & recovery (pg_dump per tenant, filestore tar)

nodes.label: Monitoring Stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Uptime Kuma)
nodes.norm_label: monitoring stack (prometheus, grafana, loki, uptime kuma)

nodes.label: Frontend/Backend Network Isolation
nodes.rationale: Backend network is internal:true so database, cache and pooler are unreachable from the internet.

nodes.label: PgBouncer Transaction-Mode Pool
nodes.rationale: Odoo opens a connection per request; 4 workers x 50 tenants exceeds PostgreSQL's connection limit, so 200 client connections are pooled into ~25 real ones.

nodes.label: Redis 7 Session Store & ORM Cache
nodes.rationale: Offloads ephemeral sessions/ORM cache from PostgreSQL (~30% load reduction), sub-ms lookups, shared session store enables horizontal scaling.

nodes.label: Scaling Strategy (horizontal web, vertical workers, DB)
nodes.norm_label: scaling strategy (horizontal web, vertical workers, db)

nodes.label: Traefik v3.1 Reverse Proxy
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Nginx because it auto-discovers Docker services via labels, so new tenant subdomains route without config reloads.

nodes.label: Per-Company Move-Version Result Cache (eh_move_version)
nodes.rationale: Atomic SQL UPDATE col=col+1 on account.move state change invalidates only changed companies; cache keyed on exact sorted company set.

nodes.label: Report Execution Audit Log (eh.account.report.execution)
nodes.rationale: Append-only row per render (user, timestamp, options snapshot, runtime, SHA-256 hash) for reproducibility; cache hits and failures also logged.

nodes.label: Whitelist-Only Parameterised SQL Builder
nodes.rationale: All values bound as parameters, identifiers from a fixed whitelist, company-scoped; plain Python unit-testable without Odoo registry.

nodes.label: Accounting Suite Base Engine (eh_account_base)
nodes.rationale: Engine module auto-installed as dependency of ERP Heritage accounting modules; user-facing reports live downstream. Badges say Odoo 19 (v19.0.1.7.0) while footer says Odoo 17 Community.

nodes.label: Multi-Stage Dockerfile
nodes.rationale: Builder stage clones repos (~500MB .git); runtime copies only module dirs (~50MB), ~70% smaller image and smaller attack surface.

nodes.label: Separate Web & Worker Containers
nodes.rationale: Heavy cron/PDF report jobs can consume 1GB+ RAM and block web workers; splitting keeps UI responsive.

nodes.label: Inter-Company Invoice Mirroring (trigger on post)
nodes.rationale: Mirror is not atomic with source post: source posts first, mirror failure recorded in chatter and flagged No mirror. No currency conversion.

nodes.label: Tax Mapping by Rate and Direction
nodes.norm_label: tax mapping by rate and direction

nodes.label: unique(origin, company) Idempotency Constraint
nodes.rationale: DB-level constraint closes the concurrent-post race a search-before-create guard would lose.

nodes.label: Inter-Company SO/PO Mirroring (eh_account_intercompany_so_po)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors land in draft for review; only product, qty, price_unit and label transferred (no taxes, analytics, discounts).
